meta_description: About Plastering in Leeds delivers expert internal and external plastering work. Reliable, quality finishes. Free quotes available. Call 07825 324175.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From crack repairs to full room replastering, we deliver smooth, durable finishes that transform your home.
services_subhead: Whether you need internal repairs, external rendering, or a full replaster, we handle every job with precision.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Smooth, flawless plaster finishes to walls and ceilings. We repair cracks, patch damage, and deliver professional surfaces ready for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable exterior finishes that protect your home and improve curb appeal. We work in cement, silicone, and acrylic renders suited to Leeds properties.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Remove outdated Artex safely and replace with modern plasterwork. Transform your ceilings into smooth, contemporary finishes.

services.title: Damp Repairs & Replastering
services.desc: We identify damp issues, treat the cause, and replaster affected areas with moisture-resistant materials to prevent recurrence.

services.title: Plaster Boarding
services.desc: Professional dry-lining and plasterboard installation for new partitions, extensions, and refurbishment projects.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Specialist textured plaster applications including Venetian finishes and decorative effects to match your interior design.

about_pullquote: We take pride in delivering plaster work that lasts and looks right.
about_para_1: About Plastering has been serving Leeds and surrounding areas for over 15 years. We've built our reputation on meticulous attention to detail, reliable turnaround times, and fair pricing. Whether you're a homeowner needing a single wall repaired or a contractor managing a large renovation, we bring the same professional standard to every job.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave your home clean and finished to a high standard. Many of our clients return to us for repeat work or recommend us to friends—that's the real measure of our success. We work across Leeds using quality materials and proven techniques that ensure your plaster stands the test of time.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a large crack down our hallway that we'd been ignoring for ages. Dave came out, quoted fairly, and got it sorted within a week. The finish is perfect—you'd never know it was damaged. Top bloke, very tidy too.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Nightmare damp patch on our bedroom ceiling. They identified the problem upstairs, fixed it, and replastered beautifully. The whole process was well explained and completed on schedule. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine B.

reviews.text: Removed all our Artex and gave us smooth modern ceilings throughout. Professional from start to finish, minimal mess, and they came back to make sure we were completely happy. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: James W.
